name: @khorsheed/dsh-typesafe-tool
description: The session-granted typesafe model tool, companion to @khorsheed/dsh-typesafe: a tool-only row (provides no service) that agent presets compose to grant `typesafe_judge` plus its guidance section and the typesafe-decide skill. Deliberately NOT self-mounting — installing it as a dependency only makes the module resolvable; an agent preset's agent.cordis.yml references the row by name.

compat.notes: Host-plane companion row: provides no service, registers the `typesafe_judge` tool, its guidance section and the typesafe-decide skill, all delegating to the global `ctx.typesafe` service core. Probes that service at apply time and silently skips registration when it is absent, so a preset naming this row still mounts cleanly. No browser half.
